arabic text:
(Ham ko bhi sikha
Bibi kaniz-e-sayyeda
Adab-e-wafa
Bibi kaniz-e-sayyeda
Ham ko bhi sikha, adab-e-wafa, tujhe
Zainab ka wasta
Ya makhduma ya fizza
english translation text:
(Teach us too
O servant of the Sayyida
The manners of loyalty
O servant of the Sayyida
Teach us too the manners of loyalty; for the sake of
Zainab
O honoured lady, O Fizza

arabic text:
Jitne zainab ke dil pe ghuzre hai,
Gham wo sab tune bhi uthaaye
hai,
Tere bhi sar se chhin gayi chadar,
Tune bhi taaziyane khaye hai
Ya makhduma ya fizza
english translation text:
Every sorrow that passed
over Zainab's heart You too
endured The veil was also
snatched from your head And
you too received lashes O
honoured lady, O Fizza

arabic text:
Bibi kaniz-e-sayyeda,
Zainab ne tujhko maa kahaa
Tera bohot hai martaba
Ya makhduma ya fizza
english translation text:
O servant of the Sayyida
Zainab called you mother
How exalted is your rank
O honoured lady, O Fizza

arabic text:
Jis ghari sheh pe chal rahi thi
chhuri,
Teri halat bayaa(n) se bahar thi,
Teri ankho(n) se khun jaari tha,
Kehti thi ayiye madad ko ali
Ya makhduma ya fizza
english translation text:
At the moment when the knife moved
Across the King's throat
Your state was beyond description
Blood flowed from your eyes
You cried: O Ali, come to help
O honoured lady, O Fizza

arabic text:
Bibi kaniz-e-sayyeda,
Maa banke har shaheed ka,
Matam kiya hai marhaba
Ya makhduma ya fizza
english translation text:
O servant of the Sayyida
Like a mother to every martyr
You performed matam—marhaba
O honoured lady, O Fizza

arabic text:
Tu kaneeze batool hai bibi,
Tu duaae rasul hai bibi,
Tu hai ehle azaa ki shahzaadi,
Farshe gham ka tu phool hai bibi
Ya makhduma ya fizza
english translation text:
You are the servant of Batul, O Lady
You are the prayer of the Messenger, O Lady
You are the princess of the mourners
A flower upon the mourning floor, O Lady
O honoured lady, O Fizza

arabic text:
Bibi kaniz-e-sayyeda,
Tu bhi agar kare duwa,
Ttal jaaye sarse har balaa
Ya makhduma ya fizza
english translation text:
O servant of the Sayyida
Should you also pray
Every calamity will be removed
O honoured lady, O Fizza

arabic text:
Waasta tujhko khune asgher ka
Waasta shahe dee(n) ki dukhtar ka
Humko amno amaa(n) ki dawlat
de
Waasta fatema ka haider ka
Ya makhduma ya fizza
english translation text:
For the sake of Asghar's
blood For the sake of the daughter
of the King of faith Grant
us the wealth of peace and safety
For the sake of Fatima and
Haider O honoured lady, O Fizza

arabic text:
Bibi kaniz-e-sayyeda,
Maqrooz momineen ka,
Hojoye karz bhi adaa
Ya makhduma ya fizza
english translation text:
O servant of the Sayyida
May the debts of indebted believers
Be fully repaid
O honoured lady, O Fizza

arabic text:
Wo jo be ghar hai unko ghar dede,
Be pisar maao ko pisar dede,
Jinke aangan me aagayi hai khiza
Unko sayaa bhara shajar dede
Ya makhduma ya fizza
english translation text:
Grant homes to those without homes
Grant sons to mothers without children
Those whose courtyards have seen autumn
Grant them a tree filled with shade
O honoured lady, O Fizza

arabic text:
Bibi kaniz-e-sayyeda,
Hum sab tere ghulaam hai
Humko hai aasra tera
Ya makhduma ya fizza
english translation text:
O servant of the Sayyida
We are all your servants
You are our support
O honoured lady, O Fizza

Tujhpar bhi hogayi jafaa,
Tera bhi sar khula raha
Ya makhduma ya fizza
english translation text:
O servant of the Sayyida
Oppression was also committed against you
Your head too remained uncovered
O honoured lady, O Fizza
